notFound.text: The link you opened isn't in the village. It may have moved, or a character may have been mistyped.

hero.eyebrow: Bat Trang · a seven-hundred-year pottery village
hero.title: Every piece of pottery carries the seal of its maker.
hero.lead: vCraft takes you into the workshops of the craft village's households. Watch them work, scan the seal under a piece to see every step it went through, then order straight from the maker.
hero.vaseAlt: A garlic-shaped vase in blue glaze

day.title: A day in Bat Trang
day.lead: From kneading clay to opening the kiln, six steps that every piece goes through. Swipe sideways to follow each one.

artisans.title: The hands that keep the craft alive
artisans.lead: Every household has its own story, its own glaze and its own way of shaping clay that nobody else shares.

map.title: Which workshops are open?
map.lead: Visit a workshop to see the wheel and the kiln for yourself. A jade dot means the workshop is welcoming visitors.
map.mapLabel: Mini map of the pottery workshops in Bat Trang

stats.title: The village in numbers
stats.years: Years the village has kept the fire

clay.name: Kneading
clay.text: The clay is filtered, rested and kneaded until every air bubble is gone.

throw.name: Throwing
throw.text: The clay goes on the wheel and the maker's hands pull it into shape.

dry.name: Drying
dry.text: It dries evenly in the shade so it won't crack in the kiln.

paint.name: Painting
paint.text: Patterns are brushed on by hand with blue underglaze.

glaze.name: Glazing
glaze.text: How thick the glaze goes on decides the shine and the shade of blue.

fire.name: Firing
fire.text: The kiln climbs past 1,200°C. Only when it opens do you see how the glaze turned out.

finish.name: Out of the kiln
finish.text: Each piece is checked one by one and sealed underneath before it leaves the workshop.

integrity.match: This code matches a demo product from {household}.
integrity.checkingText: Your browser is recomputing the SHA-256 hash of every entry itself.
integrity.okText: Your browser recomputed {count, plural, one {# SHA-256 hash} other {# SHA-256 hashes}} and all of them match, chained from the first entry to the last.
integrity.okBadge: Log chain intact · {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}
integrity.brokenTitle: This log shows signs of tampering

reason.hash: This entry's content does not match its recorded hash, so it was changed after it was written.
reason.prev: This entry does not link to the hash of the entry right before it.
reason.seq: The entry numbers are broken or out of order.

integrity.unavailableText: Verification needs Web Crypto, which is only available when the page is opened over HTTPS. The log below is not confirmed intact.
integrity.emptyText: This demo product has no production entries yet.
integrity.sentence: Journal integrity: this journal has not been silently changed, deleted or reordered since it was recorded. It does not prove the stages happened as written, nor who physically made the object.

trace.timelineLead: Each step was recorded by the maker themselves, with a photo and a hash.
trace.shortLink: Short link encoded in the QR
trace.hashHint: SHA-256 hash of this entry, chained to the one before it.

error.INVALID_TRANSITION: The request isn't in a state that allows this action.
error.MISSING_CONTEXT: Some information is missing to do this.
error.ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED: You aren't allowed to do this.
error.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Please verify your email before sending the request.
error.BIDDING_DEADLINE_TOO_SOON: The bidding deadline must be at least 24 hours after sending.
error.DELIVERY_BEFORE_BIDDING_DEADLINE: The delivery date must be after the bidding deadline.
error.DUPLICATE_BID: This household already has a bid on this request.
error.BID_NOT_SUBMITTED: Only a bid that is still active can be accepted.
error.BID_QUANTITY_MISMATCH: Only a bid that covers the full quantity can be accepted.
error.ACCEPT_WINDOW_CLOSED: The window to accept a bid (7 days after the bidding deadline) has closed.
error.PRODUCTION_START_NOT_PERMITTED: Only the coordinating Admin, or the sole household of a single-household order, can start production.
error.ALLOCATIONS_NOT_CONFIRMED: Not every household has confirmed its share yet.
error.ALLOCATIONS_NOT_DONE: Not every household has finished its share yet.
error.REASON_REQUIRED: Please give a reason for cancelling.
error.NOT_YET_EXPIRED: It isn't time for this request to expire yet.

actions.title: Actions
actions.none: Nothing more for you to do in this state.

accepted.title: Sealed.
accepted.text: You accepted the bid from {bidder}. The order is created, the other bids are declined and every household gets a notification.

bids.caption: Bids compared by unit price, total, coverage, delivery date and reputation

admin.home: Back to the vCraft home page

reason.requested: The buyer asked the management board to split the order across households.
reason.no-full-bid: No household bid for the full quantity, so several need to be combined.

capacity.name: By capacity
capacity.text: Split in proportion to each household's capacity; leftovers go to the largest remainders.

cheapest.name: Cheapest first
cheapest.text: The cheapest household fills its capacity first, then the next, until the order is covered.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.text: Split evenly; if a household hits its capacity, the rest is shared among the others.

board.statusOk: All {quantity} {unit} allocated. You can simulate sending the co-op bid.

problem.invalid: Each household's quantity must be a whole number, 0 or more.

board.partMeta: Capacity {capacity} · unit price {price} · ready in {days} days
board.demoNote: Demo: this only runs in your browser. Nothing is saved or sent to a server, and no notification goes out.
board.sendBlocked: You can simulate sending once the full quantity is allocated and no household is over capacity.

sent.title: Simulated (not saved, no notifications sent)
sent.text: The allocation plan for request {code} was only trialled in this browser. No bid has reached the buyer and no household has been notified.
